$comment: Teaching-metadata SSOT for baseline skill topic files (AI Teaching Substrate Wave 3). One entry per `<package>/<file-stem>` (matching a .md file under this dir's synap/synap-schema/synap-ui packages). Consumers: synap-backend `services/capabilities/system-skill-teaching.ts` (loads + validates this file, projects onto seeded `skills` rows) and the IS `apps/intelligence-hub/src/skills/skill-loader.ts` bundled catalog (via the synced copy at `src/skills/baseline/_teaching.json`). Edit here only — both consumers derive from this one file. A handful of IS-only bundled files (native-widget, propose-workspace, cli-execution, is-expertise) have no backend counterpart and are NOT listed here; the IS loader keeps a small hardcoded fallback entry for those.
